name: Generic Memory of Chaos floor 12 enemy
notes: Numbers from the game data (DimbreathBot/TurnBasedGameData at fe15a954eb, 4.7.0), computed 2026-11-12. Re-run with tools/gamedata/moc-enemies.mjs. ATK 625.5 is what every floor 12 enemy has at level 95 in the current period and the two before it (base 18 x level ratio 34.75065); older periods were 656.8 and 688.1. SPD 158.4 is the median floor 12 elite and boss over the last 8 Memory of Chaos periods (base 120 x 1.32). Toughness 360 is Fribbels' default and sits inside the floor 12 elite range (300 to 480). RES 0.2 is the standard non-weak value. Attack multipliers and energy are typical values for floor 12 single-target and AoE skills; the single, single, AoE order is Smitty's decision (2026-11-12), not taken from any one enemy.
